releases.name: v4.5.0
releases.body:
Omarchy 4.5 (aka Quattro RS!) is the first big feature release since [Quattro](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/releases/tag/v4.0.0), and it’s a whopper: over 740 pull requests merged from more than 180 contributors in just twelve weeks. It now offers a traditional desktop mode next to the tiling default. You can install it natively on a M1/M2/M3/Neo MacBooks. And it speaks 50 languages. And a gazillion other features, fixes, and improvements.

Release notes: https://omarchy.org/news/2026/11/omarchy-4-5/

releases.name: v4.5.0-rc3
releases.body:
> **⚠️ This is a release candidate, not a final release.** Expect bugs, rough edges, and the occasional thing that breaks outright. Run it on a test machine, or make sure you have a working backup (or a snapshot you know how to roll back to) before you upgrade a machine you depend on.

Omarchy 4.5 is the first feature release since Quattro. It speaks 50 languages, gives every monitor its own workspaces, adds floating workspaces with a dock, rebuilds notifications, gathers how the desktop looks into a new Appearance menu, plays theme intros, and ships four new default apps: Hype, Monologue, Signed, and Disktree. Underneath, it installs in about half the time, it's faster from boot to theme switching, and it runs on NVIDIA N1x and Snapdragon X laptops.

Try it on an existing machine with `Update > Channel > RC`, then `Update > Omarchy`. Please report anything that breaks on [GitHub](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues).

Install on new machines with the ISO:

**x86_64:**

- Download: [https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-x86.iso](https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-x86.iso)
- SHA256: 715d7c72d51c29a1e2db7b8f8562d54f0f5710b9c1c5a4243800be48fba24269

releases.name: v4.0.6
releases.body:
This patch release resolves a few small hiccups specific users encountered with v4.0.5.

You can upgrade existing machines with `Update > Omarchy`.

Install on new machines with the ISO:

- Download: [https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.6.iso](https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.0.6.iso)
- SHA256: b542db5fecc37395d9af6654a8146ebed225f275ae4d5a6fcf432e40afe7bb88

## Fixes

- Fix updates stopping at the OpenClaw migration from 4.0.5 by @spencerbull in #14212
- Fix the OpenClaw move stopping updates when you have your own OpenClaw by @emirb in #15875
- Fix the screen sometimes not locking before suspend by @dhh in #14978
- Fix the boot passphrase prompt using a non-Latin keyboard layout by @kevincardwell in #14885
- Fix updates stopping at the console migration when the Limine config replaces the kernel command line by @omarchybot in #15852
- Fix TUXEDO laptop drivers failing to build on the Omarchy kernel by @bastidotnet in omacom/omarchy-pkgs#1244

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/compare/v4.0.5...v4.0.6

## If you installed OpenClaw yourself
If `~/.local/bin/openclaw` is your own npm install, the update leaves it alone and doesn't move Omarch

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly opinionated, modern Linux distribution designed for aesthetics and developer productivity.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Omarchy is a modern Linux distribution created by DHH that prioritizes a beautiful, unified desktop experience with strong opinions on default tooling. Instead of requiring users to spend days configuring their environment, it ships with a cohesive ecosystem of pre-configured applications ranging from terminal emulators and Neovim to integrated AI features. It includes unique workflow enhancements like a unified clipboard history, built-in text extraction, and system-wide dictation. The operating system is documented extensively through an authoritative, built-in manual that covers everything from initial navigation to advanced CLI usage.
keyFeatures: Opinionated defaults: Ships with a pre-configured, cohesive set of tools so developers can start working immediately.
Integrated AI tools: Provides native AI integration baked directly into the operating system and default applications.
Unified clipboard: Provides a system-wide clipboard and history manager to streamline data movement between apps.
Built-in dictation: Includes native text extraction and dictation tools directly within the OS environment.
Comprehensive manual: Offers an authoritative, continuously updated built-in manual for learning the system.

useCases.title: Out-of-the-box development
useCases.description: Software engineers looking for a Linux environment that requires zero configuration to achieve a highly productive workflow.

useCases.title: Transitioning from macOS
useCases.description: Users migrating from Apple hardware who want a similarly polished, cohesive, and beautiful desktop experience on Linux.

useCases.title: Keyboard-centric navigation
useCases.description: Power users utilizing the robust set of default hotkeys and CLI tools to navigate the OS entirely via keyboard.

useCases.title: Terminal-first workflows
useCases.description: Developers relying heavily on terminal tools, Neovim, and shell functions who want them perfectly integrated by default.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Software developers, power users, and former macOS users seeking a beautiful, zero-configuration Linux experience. It is designed for those who prefer to adopt a strong set of opinionated defaults rather than spending time customizing their own desktop environment.
